paper_title: Towards a More Inclusive AI Progress and Perspectives in Large Language   Model Training for the Sámi Language
caption: The distribution of tokens and sentences across different domains in the SALT dataset is shown.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens across various categories in the SALT dataset. The horizontal axis contains the categories, listed in no particular order, and labeled as Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs. The vertical axis represents the number of tokens in thousands, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10,000, marked at regular intervals of 2000. Each category is represented by a blue bar, with the following approximate values: Blogs, at the shortest, has 32 thousand tokens, while the tallest, News, has 10584 thousand tokens; other categories have the following values: Administrative, 6472; Science, 1626; Non-fiction, 1889; Religion, 652; Fiction, 387; and Law, 354. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no visual emphasis is applied to any of them.
